text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Misogi... This place really does seem quite scary...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミソギ～、
やっぱりここ、
ちょっと怖いよ～

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine, Kyoka! Mister {0}'s with us and stuff!
Ooh, look! I think the path goes even deeper!
It's not scary if we're together, so let's check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよキョウカ！　
にいちゃんもいるんだし！
あ、
ほら！　
まだ奥に道が続いてるみたい！
みんなで進めば怖くないし、いってみよ！
